intent: Ordinary world: Renee walks to work on a bright weekday morning, busy and capable, before anything breaks.
subject: Renee, full figure, walking along a city sidewalk from screen-left toward screen-right, seen in profile with her right side toward the camera, coffee cup in her left hand and the canvas tote on her right shoulder.
composition: She starts at the left third of the frame and travels to the right third. Foreground: the edge of a painted green street-tree planter at the bottom left. Midground: Renee on a pale grey sidewalk. Background: a row of painted brownstone shopfronts with striped awnings in coral and teal, a bus stop shelter at screen-right, and soft painted morning haze above the rooftops.

action.start: The clip opens on the first frame: Renee mid-stride at the left third, left foot forward, coffee cup at chest height.
action.end: She reaches the right third of the frame, slows, glances down at her phone held in her right hand, and keeps walking out toward screen-right as the clip ends with her still inside the frame.
action.direction: She walks from screen-left to screen-right at an easy brisk pace, about one stride per second, her body in profile the whole time and her face turning a few degrees toward the camera only when she glances at the phone.

camera.plain: The camera tracks alongside her, moving toward screen-right at the same speed as her walk, so she stays roughly centred while the shopfronts slide from screen-right to screen-left behind her. The camera stays at her shoulder height and does not tilt.

lens_light: Painted equivalent of a 35 mm medium-wide framing, full figure with a little headroom. Morning sun from screen-left at a low angle paints a warm golden key on her face and coat and throws a long soft shadow toward screen-right along the sidewalk. Teal shade fills the shopfront doorways. Flat illustrated depth, with the background a slightly softer brush pass than the characters.
motion_physics: Her coat hem swings with each stride and lags a fraction behind her legs. The tote bounces gently against her hip on each step. Steam rises from the coffee cup and drifts backward toward screen-left because she is moving forward. Her heels lift and land with clear weight; her feet never slide on the sidewalk. Her free arm swings in a short arc.
beats: Two full strides from the left third, eyes forward, a small sip of coffee.
She passes the bus shelter at screen-right of centre; her phone buzzes and she lifts it in her right hand to chest height.
She glances down at the screen, slows by half a step, then keeps walking toward screen-right, still inside the frame at the end.
